elo_diff.description: Home minus away pre-game Elo rating
elo_diff.definition: elo_home_entering - elo_away_entering; Elo update r += K*(actual - expected), expected = 1/(1+10**((r_opp - r_self)/400)); actual = 1 win / 0 loss / 0.5 tie
elo_diff.source: nflverse schedules (all decided REG games, 2018 warmup onward)
elo_diff.point_in_time_rule: rating entering kickoff; updated only AFTER a game settles
elo_diff.missing_value_policy: ELO_PRIOR (1500) for a team's first-ever game; never NaN

win_pct_diff.description: Home minus away trailing win percentage
win_pct_diff.definition: mean(team_win) over the team's prior 12 games (ties = 0.5)
win_pct_diff.point_in_time_rule: per-team rolling(12).mean().shift(1) — current and future games excluded
win_pct_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the team has no prior games; in-model handling

rest_days_diff.description: Home minus away days since each team's previous game
rest_days_diff.point_in_time_rule: days since the team's own strictly-prior game
rest_days_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN for a team's first game of the window; in-model handling

is_dome_home.description: Home venue roof is a dome (or closed retractable)
is_dome_home.definition: 1.0 if roof in {dome, closed}; 0.0 if outdoors; NaN unknown
is_dome_home.missing_value_policy: NaN when roof is unknown/unlisted (e.g. international sites); never fabricated

ewm_net_pts_diff.description: Home minus away exponentially-weighted net points per game
ewm_net_pts_diff.definition: ewm(halflife=2).mean() of the team's net points (for - against) over strictly-prior games
ewm_net_pts_diff.point_in_time_rule: per-team ewm over prior games then shift(1)
ewm_net_pts_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the team has no prior games

ewm_ypp_diff.description: Home minus away exponentially-weighted net yards per play
ewm_ypp_diff.definition: ewm(halflife=2).mean() of the team's game-level yards_gained/n_plays over strictly-prior games
ewm_ypp_diff.aggregation: per-team EWM of per-game yardage efficiency
ewm_ypp_diff.point_in_time_rule: per-team ewm over prior games then shift(1)
ewm_ypp_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when no prior games or PBP unavailable for a season

pace_plays_min_diff.description: Home minus away trailing plays per minute
pace_plays_min_diff.definition: trailing 4-game mean of n_plays/elapsed_min per game
pace_plays_min_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when prior games lack clock data

rest_short_diff.description: Home minus away short-rest flag (rest < 7 days)
rest_short_diff.definition: 1.0 when rest_days < 7 else 0.0; home flag minus away flag
rest_short_diff.point_in_time_rule: function of the team's strictly-prior game date
rest_short_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when either team has no prior game

div_game.definition: 1.0 when home and away share a division else 0.0
div_game.missing_value_policy: NaN when the source field is missing

travel_miles_diff.description: Home minus away distance traveled to the venue (miles)
travel_miles_diff.definition: haversine(team home stadium, game stadium) home minus away; earth radius 3958.8 mi
travel_miles_diff.source: committed nfl_stadiums.csv (real coordinates) + nflverse stadium names
travel_miles_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when a stadium is missing from the table; never fabricated

altitude_home.missing_value_policy: NaN when the venue is missing from the table

is_turf_home.description: Home venue playing surface is artificial turf
is_turf_home.definition: 1.0 when the schedule surface normalizes to a turf family (fieldturf/matrixturf/sportturf/astroturf/a_turf); 0.0 when grass; NaN when unlisted
is_turf_home.missing_value_policy: NaN when surface is unlisted/blank; never fabricated

temp_f.description: Observed game-day temperature (F) at the game venue
temp_f.definition: daily mean temperature on the game date from the committed observed-weather table (build_weather_table.py, Open-Meteo archive); schedule temp payload as fallback
temp_f.point_in_time_rule: observed game-day environment, known before kickoff
temp_f.missing_value_policy: NaN for domes/international/missing rows; never fabricated

wind_mph.description: Observed game-day wind speed (mph) at the game venue
wind_mph.definition: daily max sustained wind speed on the game date from the committed observed-weather table; schedule wind payload as fallback
wind_mph.point_in_time_rule: observed game-day environment, known before kickoff
wind_mph.missing_value_policy: NaN for domes/international/missing rows; never fabricated

is_precip.description: Observed precipitation at the game venue (game day)
is_precip.definition: 1.0 when observed daily precipitation >= PRECIP_FLAG_IN (0.1 in), 0.0 otherwise; NaN unknown
is_precip.point_in_time_rule: observed game-day environment, known before kickoff
is_precip.missing_value_policy: NaN when the weather table lacks the (stadium, gameday) row; never fabricated

is_snow.description: Observed snowfall at the game venue (game day)
is_snow.definition: 1.0 when observed daily snowfall >= SNOW_FLAG_IN (0.1 in), 0.0 otherwise; NaN unknown
is_snow.point_in_time_rule: observed game-day environment, known before kickoff
is_snow.missing_value_policy: NaN when the weather table lacks the (stadium, gameday) row; never fabricated

inj_qb_out_diff.description: Home minus away QBs ruled Out on the week's report
inj_qb_out_diff.definition: count of QBs with report_status == 'Out' on the week's injury report, home minus away
inj_qb_out_diff.point_in_time_rule: the week's published report — known before kickoff
inj_qb_out_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the season's report is unavailable; never fabricated

inj_tackle_out_diff.description: Home minus away tackles ruled Out on the week's report
inj_tackle_out_diff.definition: count of T/OT/LT/RT with report_status == 'Out' on the week's injury report, home minus away
inj_tackle_out_diff.point_in_time_rule: the week's published report — known before kickoff
inj_tackle_out_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the season's report is unavailable; never fabricated

inj_edge_out_diff.description: Home minus away edge rushers ruled Out on the week's report
inj_edge_out_diff.definition: count of EDGE/DE/OLB/OL with report_status == 'Out' on the week's injury report, home minus away
inj_edge_out_diff.point_in_time_rule: the week's published report — known before kickoff
inj_edge_out_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the season's report is unavailable; never fabricated

inj_starters_out_diff.description: Home minus away players ruled Out on the week's report
inj_starters_out_diff.definition: count of ALL players with report_status == 'Out' on the week's injury report, home minus away
inj_starters_out_diff.point_in_time_rule: the week's published report — known before kickoff
inj_starters_out_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the season's report is unavailable; never fabricated

is_home.description: Constant 1.0 anchor for the home-field edge
is_home.representation: constant anchor (part of the served contract; every family receives it)
is_home.role: anchor — in config.MONEYLINE_FEATURE_COLS, so trees receive it too
